title: Account for impairment and derecognition of finite life intangible assets

items.concept: Initial recognition of finite-life patent; subsequent measurement schedule; period-end adjusting JEs for amortization and two-step impairment; post-impairment amortization on new cost basis
Number-variant twin — initial recognition; subsequent measurement schedule; period-end amortization and impairment AJs; post-impairment amortization
Period-end impairment testing on two finite-life intangibles (one fails recoverability, one passes); amortize to disposal date and record sale gain/loss
Distinguish recoverability test (undiscounted cash flows) from impairment measurement (fair value)
After impairment, adjusted carrying amount is the new accounting basis; subsequent reversal of impairment is prohibited
Full finite-life intangible life cycle with period-end AJs, impairment, revised schedule, and mid-year derecognition
